summary: # **CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI** # ** Petition No. 220/MP/2023 ** **Coram:** **Shri Jishnu Barua, Chairperson Shri Ramesh Babu V., Member Shri Harish Dudani, Member Shri Ravinder Singh Dhillon, Member** **Date of Order: 13** **th** **July, 2025** # **In the matter of** Petition under Section 79(1)(c) read with Section 79(1)(f) of the Electricity Act, 2003 seeking a direction against Respondent No. 1 to pay compensation, being the increase in cost of Tariff due to blending of imported coal. # **And In the matter of** **D.B. Power Limited,** 5 th Floor Office Block 1A, DB City Park, DB City Arera Hills, Opposite M.P. Nagar Zone-I, Bhopal-462 016, Madhya Pradesh ** Petitioner** # **Versus** # **1. Gujarat Urja Vikas Nigam Limited,** Sardar Patel Vidyut Bhawan Race Course, Vadodara–390007. # **2. Manikaran Power Limited,** Manikaran Tower, Kilburn Colony, P.O. Hinoo Ranchi-834002, Jharkhand. ** Respondents** # ** ORDER ** The Petitioner, D.B. Power Limited, has filed the present Petition with the following prayers: “a. _Direct Respondent No. 1 to pay compensation, being the increase in cost of Tariff due to blending of imported coal, as claimed by the Petitioner in its supplementary invoice dated 10.02.2023 [Annexure P-13 (Colly)] read with Credit Note dated 25.03.2023 [Annexure P-16 (Colly)] along with interest payable thereon till actual payment of the said compensations;_ Order in Petition No. 220/MP/2023 Page 1 _b. Pending final adjudication of the present Petition, pass an ex-parte ad interim order, directing Respondent No. 1 to forthwith secure and make payment of the compensation in terms of prayer (a) above; and_ _c. Pass any such other and further reliefs as this Commission deems just and proper in the nature and circumstances of the present case.”_ 2. The Petitioner, vide its affidavit dated 8.11.2024, has sought permission for withdrawal of the instant Petition. 3. In view of the submissions of the Petitioner, the Petitioner is permitted to withdraw the present Petition. 4. Accordingly, Petition No. 220/MP/2023 is disposed of as withdrawn. **Sd/sd/sd/sd/(Ravinder Singh Dhillon) (Harish Dudani) (Ramesh Babu V.) (Jishnu Barua) Member Member Member Chairperson** Order in Petition No. 220/MP/2023 Page 2 CERC Website S. No. 467/2025
